items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: That was just about the time that we were both playing with, with Schilling.

ctx.x: Did you work with that band or was it just?
No, that band was just made up for, for, for that recording. Oh, I, Johnny worked in, in Schilling's band. That was just about the time that we were both playing with, with Schilling.
Was there a particular style you were aiming for in that record, the band?
